reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is rendering interactive charts, panels, forms, quizzes, diagrams, and other UI components inline in assistant replies, with optional interaction events sent back to the model.

summaries.zh: 在助手回复中渲染可交互的数据面板、图表、表单、测验、流程图和其他界面组件。
summaries.en: Renders interactive data panels, charts, forms, quizzes, diagrams, and other interface components inline in assistant replies.

capabilities: Renders interactive UI components inside assistant replies
Displays charts, plots, diagrams, forms, quizzes, and 3D scenes
Persists UI state locally per session and content fingerprint
Sends configured interaction events back to the model
Loads optional rendering assets through plugin-hosted HTTP routes
